newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Investments in Philippine economic zones surge.
newsitem.headline: Investments in Philippine economic zones surge.

text.p: Investments in the Philippines' special economic zones surged to 85.91 billion pesos in the first five months of the year from 11.37 billion pesos registered in the same period last year, the Philippine Economic Zone Authority said on Friday.
The number of new enterprises was lower at 44 against 55 last year, but the project costs were sharply higher at 29.52 billion pesos from 7.15 billion last year.
Expansions by existing companies totalled 5.26 billion pesos compared with 2.18 billion pesos.
Investments in facilities at the zones rose to 331.75 million pesos from 250.67 million in 1996.
Investments in expansion of zone sites reached 50.79 billion pesos from 1.80 billion pesos.
